title: ball_sahi_next_test
ranking_note: Gemini next-gen SAHI D1–D10 vs fallback-only winner
page_note: Next SAHI attempts from deep research (sparse logit, WBF, DIoU, EMA tile, soft-edge, motion ROI, ASAHI grid, conditional SR, DotD gate, entropy crop). D1/D10 use low-threshold detects as encoder-query proxies; D6 uses motion ROIs (no person head on ball checkpoint). Same P10 Top Left clip.

variants.title: 1. D1 Sparse logit tiles
variants.why: On empty full-frame, tile only around subthreshold (0.10–0.29) detects as logit proxy.

variants.title: 2. D2 Fallback + WBF merge
variants.why: Standard fallback grid; Weighted Boxes Fusion instead of hard NMS.

variants.title: 3. D3 Fallback + Cluster-DIoU-NMS
variants.why: Centroid-aware suppress for tiny-ball tile duplicates (<15px).

variants.title: 4. D4 Temporal EMA motion tile
variants.why: One tile on EMA-projected (x,y) when empty — verify with network, no Kalman coast.

variants.title: 5. D5 Soft edge penalty
variants.why: Down-weight tile dets near tile borders (truncation FPs), then NMS.

variants.title: 6. D6 Motion-ROI tiles (player proxy)
variants.why: No person head on ball ckpt — tile only where frame-diff motion is high.

variants.title: 7. D7 Adaptive ASAHI grid
variants.why: Far pitch (top): 640px tiles; near (bottom): 1024px — then WBF.

variants.title: 8. D8 Conditional SR tile
variants.why: One tile on best subthreshold center, 1.5× upscale, detect, scale back.

variants.title: 9. D9 DotD track gate
variants.why: Fallback grid + WBF, then emit only if linked by Dot Distance to prior.

variants.title: 10. D10 Entropy/uncertainty crop
variants.why: Tile on detection closest to conf=0.5 (uncertainty proxy) when empty.
